plan.goal: Detect a 1.0-sigma difference between treated and control group means in a liver chip with 80% power at alpha 0.05.
plan.rationale: Two-sample comparison of treated vs control in a perfused liver chip. Effect size is expressed in sigma units (effect_size = 1.0, std_dev = 1.0), so the required n is the classic 16 per group for a two-sided t-test at 80% power, alpha 0.05. This is a biological-replicate count (independent chip cultures per group), not technical replicates.
caveats: n=16 is per biological replicate (independent chip cultures), not technical replicates of the same culture.
Confirm the 1.0-sigma effect size is realistic for the endpoint (e.g. extraction ratio, albumin, CYP activity) before committing to the cohort.
If the assay CV is high, consider adding technical replicates within each biological replicate to bound the SEM.

provenance.formula: n from two-sample t-test power equation
